description:
For distinct \(p,q\), ordered search on \([p,q]\) and \([(
eg p\lor q),(
eg p\lor
eg q),(p\lor q)]\) fails in the first branch \(p=1\) and returns exactly the valuation \(p=0,q=1\), with all other atoms zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.branch_trace.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p q : α) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.branchExample p q) =
      [[{ atom := q, positive := true }], [{ atom := q, positive := false }]] ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.solve [q]
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.branchExample p q)) =
        none ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p false
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.branchExample p q) =
          [[{ atom := q, positive := true }]] ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.solve [p, q]
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.branchExample p q) =
          some (Function.update (Function.update (fun x => false) q true) p false)
